# scripts/Interaction/AlarmBell.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Interaction/AlarmBell.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Frobbable/guard-operated alarm with cooldown and timed tolls.
ring() broadcasts the supplied destination, raises the player garrison
alarm, and emits rung; player frob uses the bell position as destination.

Base: `StaticBody3D`. Registered class: `none`.
